description: Datasets for the publication " Enhancing drought resilience and energy security through complementing hydro by offshore wind power - the case of Brazil is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Paula Borba (Aeronautics Institute of Technology and Delft University of Technologyand Delft). Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
